hero.title: Gig, 500, or 300 Mbps: the specs side by side
hero.subtitle: See exactly how our three most popular Internet plans stack up on speed, price, data, and perks so you can pick the right fit in a glance.
intro.title: Every spec that matters, in one grid
intro.body: Each column is a plan, each row is a spec. The differences come down to speed and price, while unlimited data, the xFi Gateway, and a free mobile line stay the same across all three.
item-1.name: Xfinity Gig Internet
item-2.name: Xfinity Internet 500 Mbps
item-3.name: Xfinity Internet 300 Mbps
diff.title: The differences that actually matter
diff.c1body: Gig handles dozens of 4K streams, heavy gaming, and big downloads at once. 500 Mbps keeps a busy family smooth, and 300 Mbps nails everyday streaming and working from home.
diff.c2body: All three plans include the xFi Gateway, unlimited data, same-day self-install, and a 5-year price guarantee, so you never pay extra for the essentials.
diff.c3body: Every plan comes with a free Xfinity Mobile line for a year, so you cut your phone bill no matter which speed you choose.
cta.title: Ready to lock in your speed?
cta.body: Pick the plan that fits your home, self-install in minutes, and add a free mobile line whenever you want.
